answer: Propose one daily permit per AI key relaying gale warnings. Validators send 1 GB of unpredictable cipher output unique to each key/day and require its full echo within 100 seconds. Short, late or replayed streams get no permit. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse counted bytes. Traffic recurs; servers are reusable capital; no stake. Honest meters are assumed; cheap links lower costs, and the test proves neither distinct owners nor future uptime. Ten keys need 10 GB/day of return traffic; validators bear matching traffic load.
